name: Panvaree The Greenery
type: Floating Raft House (luxury eco floating resort)

rooms.type: Superior Floating Room (couple, A/C, private deck + lake steps)
2D1N all-inclusive package (per person: transfer + longtail tours + meals)

highlights: Genuinely intimate: capacity strictly capped at ~30-35 guests/day, so it feels private and calm versus the crowded rustic rafts on the lake
Private A/C teak-and-eco-material floating villas with glass doors, private deck and steps straight down into the emerald Cheow Lan water
Free kayaks available any time — you can swim or paddle right off your own room, plus dawn 'morning mist' longtail rides and night boat trips
Outstanding staff and location scores on Booking (9.8 staff, 9.9 location); family-style Thai meals and welcome fruit juice widely praised
All-inclusive packages include guided jungle hikes, Coral Cave / Nam Talu cave tours and scenic longtail boat trips inside Khao Sok National Park
Spectacular setting ringed by towering limestone karst cliffs and warm, clear jade-green water — the classic 'Guilin of Thailand' scenery
cons: Air-conditioning runs on the generator only ~6 PM-6 AM; expect weak/no WiFi and low cell signal — this is off-grid rainforest, not a city hotel
Very remote and hard to reach independently: ~1.5h drive to Ratchaprapha (Cheow Lan) pier, then a ~30-min longtail boat — most guests come via the resort's own transfer/tour package
Premium price for fairly basic room amenities; payment is cash-only on site with a wire-transfer deposit required to book
Jungle realities: hot, humid, insects and sudden rain; no beach — this is lake-and-rainforest, and a couple of reviewers noted limited vegetarian options
notes:
VERIFIED REAL & OPERATING (2025-2026). Cheow Lan Lake floating raft, Khao Sok National Park, Surat Thani (122 Moo 3, T. Khao Phang, A. Ban Ta Khun). Established 2013, registered under the Dept. of National Parks eco-community tourism scheme; TripAdvisor Travelers' Choice 2026.

IMPORTANT — two similarly-named properties exist; do NOT confuse them: (1) 'Panvaree The Greenery' = this luxury tier, and (2) the cheaper standard 'Panvaree Resort' (~฿3,500, booking.com/hotel/th/panvaree-resort.html, agoda panvaree-resort). This review is the GREENERY. Both are bookable, but the affiliate links above are the correct Greenery-specific detail pages.

BOOKABLE OTA CONFIRMED: has its own dedicated Booking.com page (9.4/10 'Superb' from 361 verified reviews — cleanliness 9.4, comfort 9.3, location 9.9, staff 9.8, value 8.8) AND its own Agoda page (listed as 3-star, agoda hotel id h79787288). Also on Trip.com (hotel-detail-15048883), Expedia (h19777319), Hotels.com, KAYAK (from ~$158). I could NOT scrape live numeric Agoda/Trip.com guest scores (both OTA pages are JS-gated and returned empty to WebFetch) — left those fields blank rather than invent them; Booking 9.4 and TripAdvisor 4.1/5 (237 reviews, ranked #7 of 10 Khao Sok hotels) are firmly confirmed.

PRICING NOTE: The Greenery sells mainly as all-inclusive multi-day packages, not pure room-only. Real first-hand blog (roadslesstraveled.us): a 3D2N tour was ฿14,900 total for two people + ฿600/pp park entry. OTA room-only rates start roughly ฿6,000/night (KAYAK ~$158, TripAdvisor range ~$141-457, other guides quote $250-400/night once meals/activities are bundled). Room THB figures above are realistic estimates for the room tier; treat packages as the normal booking mode. Private longtail transfer ~฿2,400 each way if arranged separately; national park entry (~฿300 Thai / ฿600 foreigner) is extra.

GETTING THERE (Khao Sok-specific): minivan/taxi ~1.5h from Surat Thani or ~2.5-3h from Phuket/Krabi to the Khao Sok area, then continue to Ratchaprapha Dam / Cheow Lan pier, then a ~30-min (some sources up to 45-min) longtail boat to the raft. Practically only reachable via the resort's transfer or a tour package; recommend overnighting near the pier the night before. Free pier-to-resort boat transfer is included per Booking. Cash-only on site; 50% deposit by wire transfer to reserve.

Room types are not rigidly published; verified categories from OTA/official data are Superior (couple), Deluxe/Mountain-view, and Family floating rooms/villas — all A/C, ensuite with shower, private balcony/deck with direct water access. Free kayaks confirmed.

name: Praiwan Raft House

rooms.type: Deluxe bamboo bungalow, room-only (fan, en-suite bathroom, lake-view veranda) — cheapest OTA rate
Deluxe bungalow 2D1N full-board package (2 pax: r/t longtail transfer, 3 meals, Coral Cave + safari tours, park fees)
Family room 2D1N full-board package (larger raft unit, 2 pax base)

highlights: Genuine floating bamboo village of ~30 pontoon bungalows in the middle of Cheow Lan Lake, each with a PRIVATE en-suite bathroom and a lake-view veranda — a real rarity, as most Khao Sok rafts have shared or no bathrooms
Breathtaking 'Guilin of Thailand' limestone-karst scenery over emerald water, with wildlife (gibbons, monkeys, hornbills, macaques) right from the balcony
Food is a standout — hearty full-board Thai meals repeatedly called some of 'the best we had in Thailand,' with generous portions and good vegetarian/tofu options
Warm, genuinely friendly and helpful staff frequently singled out in recent reviews
All-inclusive packages bundle round-trip longtail transfers, Coral Cave exploration, scenic day cruise, evening wildlife safari, morning-mist safari, park entry and a local guide
One of the very few Cheow Lan Lake rafts bookable on BOTH Booking.com AND Agoda (also Trip.com + official praiwanrafthouse.com) — easy, credible booking for foreign travellers
cons: Rustic and basic by design: electricity only during limited generator hours (often evenings), little-to-no wifi and no phone signal, cold showers, thin see-through curtains and occasional insects/cockroaches reported

Getting there is a real commitment — minivan/taxi ~1.5h from Surat Thani (2.5-3h from Phuket/Krabi) to the Khlong Sok/Ratchaprapha (Cheow Lan) pier, then a 1h+ longtail boat; practically reachable only via a transfer or tour package, not a self-drive drop-off
Some recent reviews cite weak communication on meal times / activity schedules and undisclosed extra fees (national park 300 THB, pier 40 THB) charged on arrival
Jungle heat and humidity, fan-only (no aircon), no beach — this is rainforest-and-lake, not a resort; one night feels rushed, most guests recommend two
notes:
SCORE: overall ~8.6 (Booking blocked scraping; the 9.8 seen was the LOCATION sub-score, not overall; TripAdvisor 4.2/5=8.4). Rustic 2-star fan-only bamboo raft, well-liked for setting+food. VERIFIED REAL and currently operating (2025-2026). Confirmed live hotel-detail pages on Booking.com (hotel/th/praiwanrafthouse-aephaiphrwaly.html, listed as "PraiwanRaftHouse แพไพรวัลย์", Ban Wang Khon), Agoda (praiwanrafthouse/hotel/khao-sok-suratthani-th.html), Trip.com (two detail IDs: 11127737 and 102347353 "praiwanrafthouse"), plus TripAdvisor (d14098190, "Updated 2026 Prices"). So a bookable affiliate link EXISTS on both Agoda and Booking.com — the known context checks out.

SUB-ZONE: Cheow Lan Lake floating raft house on the Ratchaprapha (Rajjaprabha) Dam reservoir, administrative address 45/16 Moo 9, Ban Ta Khun district, Surat Thani (~23 mi from Surat Thani airport). NOT a Khlong Sok land lodge.

TYPE/SIZE: ~30 bamboo floating bungalows on pontoons connected by wooden walkways; each has a private en-suite bathroom, ceiling fan, and private lake-view veranda. Two categories on the official site — Deluxe (~11 units) and larger Family rooms. Official site is praiwanrafthouse.com (also mirrored via roomscope reservation system id 2042).

PRICING nuance: OTA room-only base rate lands around ฿2,800-3,000/night (matches "from ~฿3,000" context). BUT the way this raft is normally sold is as an all-inclusive package: official site quotes 2D1N Deluxe from ฿11,500 and Family from ฿14,500 (for 2 people, full board + longtail transfers + Coral Cave/safari tours + park fees). TripAdvisor shows standard rooms ~$193-285/night which reflects the package/full-board equivalent. Report the ฿3,000 room-only figure as the "cheapest bookable per-night" but flag in the article that most guests pay the package rate.

SCORES: Booking overall numeric score and Agoda/Trip.com numeric scores are behind anti-bot walls (HTTP 418 / JS-rendered) and could not be scraped directly; do not fabricate exact figures. Solid proxies gathered: TripAdvisor 4.2/5 (29 reviews), #2 of 16 specialty lodging in Ban Ta Khun; Booking couples-location sub-score 9.8/10; qualitative Booking reviews strongly positive ("Absolutely spectacular and unique," "wonderful stay"). If the site needs exact OTA scores, pull them live via the browser/Chrome tool when logged in.

Star rating 2 is my estimate (rustic eco raft, fan-only) — OTAs generally list it unrated or 2-star. No official star classification.

name: Our Jungle House
zone: Khlong Sok village / near park HQ (land jungle lodge)
highlights: Pioneer of Khao Sok ecotourism (operating since the mid-1980s / 1985) — the original treehouse resort in the area, set on ~25 acres of private rainforest along the Sok River
Genuinely unique elevated wooden treehouses and bungalows built from natural materials with open cross-ventilation, mosquito nets, hot showers and private decks over the jungle/river
Walkable to the Khao Sok National Park entrance/HQ — one of the most convenient land bases in Khlong Sok village, no long transfer needed
Immersive nature: 3 free guest-only jungle trails on-site, frequent wildlife/birdsong, and a strong sustainability ethos (organic garden supplying the kitchen, eco toiletries)
Well-regarded open-air riverside restaurant serving Thai and international dishes with fresh local produce
Full activity desk: Cheow Lan Lake day trips and overnight raft-house tours, ethical elephant experiences, night jungle hikes, river tubing and cooking classes
cons: No air-conditioning (fans only) — the jungle heat and humidity under a mosquito net can be uncomfortable, and open-air rooms let in insects (guests report hornets/bugs indoors)
Basic amenities by design: no in-room WiFi or TV (WiFi only in the restaurant area), dim room lighting and limited power outlets/fridges
Some guests feel it is pricey for the rustic facilities versus cheaper Khlong Sok guesthouses, and report add-on tour fees not clearly explained upfront
Mixed service notes — a few reviewers found reception curt or dismissive ('check the book / go online'), and the optional Cheow Lan Lake raft overnights can feel worn for the price
This is rainforest + river, not a beach — expect rain, mud and a genuine wilderness setting rather than resort polish
notes: VERIFIED REAL and currently operating (2025-2026). Real bookable affiliate pages confirmed on BOTH Agoda (hotel id h18863771) and Booking.com (our-jungle-house-suraasdrthaanii) — plus Trip.com (id 22088744, ~57-58 reviews), Expedia (h27266334) and Hotels.com. TripAdvisor: 4.4/5, 1,312 reviews, ranked #4 of 10 Khao Sok hotels (d596000) — matches the brief. SUB-ZONE: this is a LAND jungle lodge in Khlong Sok village, right by the park HQ/entrance — NOT a Cheow Lan Lake raft house. It sells lake raft-house overnights only as optional tours (guests are driven ~1hr to Ratchaprapha/Cheow Lan pier then longtail ~1hr+). Getting there: minivan/taxi ~1.5h from Surat Thani, or ~2.5-3h from Phuket/Krabi, to Khlong Sok. Property specifics: ~17 treehouses + ~5 bungalows, fan-only, no AC/TV, WiFi only in restaurant. SCORES: Booking couples sub-score 9.2 and Expedia 9.2 'Wonderful' are documented; the exact single Booking/Agoda overall numbers could not be scraped (both sites block automated fetch and Trip.com returned HTTP 418), so scoreBooking 9.0 / scoreAgoda 8.8 (aligns with Tropki 8.9) / scoreTrip 8.8 (45 positive of 57) are best-estimate approximations — verify live before publishing. PRICES: Booking shows roughly $47-130/night (~฿1,600-4,500); 'from ~฿1,600' (Nature Bungalow, low season) confirmed reasonable. Room-type prices above are indicative and seasonal. Agoda URL returned WITHOUT cid as required.

name: Anurak Community Lodge
zone: Khlong Sok village / near park HQ (land jungle lodge)

rooms.type: Room-only special / cheapest bookable (2 guests, no meals)
Deluxe Green Bungalow, incl. breakfast (2 pax)

highlights: Award-winning genuine sustainability program (won Responsible Tourism Accommodation at the 2024 Responsible Thailand Awards; Travelife-certified; former palm-oil plantation reforested with native species via the 'Rainforest Rising' initiative in partnership with a university)
Spacious, characterful Deluxe Green Bungalows on stilts in rainforest gardens — studios with king beds, wraparound balconies, semi-open bathrooms with rainfall showers, mosquito-net canopies
The open-air Hornbill restaurant is a genuine highlight: sweeping views over jungle and limestone karsts, quality locally-sourced Thai meals
Real community model — many local villagers work as guides and staff; organised jungle walks, bamboo/river rafting, cave trips and Thai cookery classes
Excellent, attentive staff repeatedly praised for going above and beyond
Right on the edge of Khao Sok National Park, deep-rainforest immersion with wildlife and birdlife around the property
cons: Basic, ageing rooms noted by some recent guests — worn furnishings, no fridge/TV, occasional maintenance and cleanliness lapses (stained bedding, mosquito nets with small holes needing tape)
Wi-Fi only reliably works at the restaurant/public areas, not in the bungalows
Remote and isolated — few dining alternatives nearby and a taxi to town runs about 900 THB, so guests can feel 'trapped'; on-site activities and drinks are relatively pricey
Jungle realities: heat, humidity, insects and rain (visits in shoulder/green season can be very wet); thin soundproofing between stilted bungalows
notes:
CONFIRMED real and currently operating (2025-2026). This is a LAND jungle lodge in Khlong Sok village on the edge of Khao Sok National Park (Phanom district, Surat Thani) — NOT a Cheow Lan Lake raft house. It sits roughly 4 km from the Cheow Lan/Ratchaprapha lake area but functions as a park-HQ-side jungle lodge; the lake and its floating rafts require a separate drive to the pier plus a longtail boat (~1h+), usually via a tour. Getting there: minivan/taxi from Surat Thani town/airport (~1.5h, ~35 mi) or transfer from Phuket/Krabi (~2.5-3h, ~150 km north of Phuket) to Khlong Sok. SHA Extra Plus certified. 19 eco rooms across 12 bungalows + 1 safari tent; air-con + high-ceiling fans + mosquito nets; refillable natural toiletries.

Bookable affiliate pages CONFIRMED to exist: Agoda (two listing variants: /anurak-community-lodge_2/hotel/suratthani-th.html and /anurak-community-lodge/hotel/khlong-sok-th.html), Booking.com (/hotel/th/anurak-community-lodge.html), Trip.com (phanom-hotel-detail-6139866), plus Expedia/Hotels.com/KAYAK.

SCORES: Trip.com 8.3/10 (~42-47 reviews). TripAdvisor 4.0/5 from 151 reviews, ranked #2 of 12 B&Bs/inns in Khlong Sok (TripAdvisor uses /5, not /10 — did not include in scoreTrip). Booking.com and Agoda exact numeric guest scores could NOT be scraped (both sites returned bot-blocked/empty bodies to WebFetch); left blank rather than fabricate — pull live before publishing. Booking.com typically shows this property in the high-8s.

PRICING: Official site (anuraklodge.com/packages-specials) quotes Deluxe Bungalow w/ breakfast ~THB 2,190/room (2 pax); room-only special ~THB 900-1,200/night; KAYAK 'from $48' (~THB 1,700). Realistic cheapest bookable set to ~THB 1,290; the THB 900 figure is a promo room-only rate. Safari-tent and family-room prices are approximate estimates (not confirmed on a live rate page). Star rating best described as 3-star / boutique eco-lodge (classified as B&B/Inn on TripAdvisor, SHA-rated). Photos: official site accommodation page and TripAdvisor photo galleries have real, recent guest/property photos.

name: Khao Sok Las Orquideas Resort
zone: Khlong Sok village / near park HQ (land jungle lodge)

rooms.type: Standard Garden Bungalow (A/C, hot water, WiFi)

highlights: Only ~9 bungalows on a lushly landscaped tropical garden plot, ~2 minutes' walk/drive from the Khao Sok National Park entrance and the Khlong Sok village strip of cafes, bars, massage and tour shops
Consistently rated the best value-for-money stay in Khao Sok: TripAdvisor 4.7/5 (614+ reviews, #2 of 10 hotels) and Booking.com 8.8/10 with a standout 9.4 for couples
Warm, hands-on hospitality from owners Sisco & Nee and staff (Booking staff subscore 9.6) who personally arrange lake tours, night safaris and the Elephant sanctuary
Modern Thai-decor A/C bungalows with hot water, strong free WiFi (Booking WiFi subscore 9.8), and private balconies/terraces facing jungle and limestone-cliff views
Real jungle immersion right at the property: monkeys, birds and lizards in the garden, jungle sounds at night, and a small pool for cooling off
Excellent location score (9.5) and genuinely low rates from ~฿1,800/night make it a rare budget pick that still feels boutique
cons: Some bungalow interiors are dark and a few bathrooms/facilities are dated and due for renovation (occasional 'run-down' comments)
Steep paths and stairs to reach some hillside bungalows — awkward with heavy luggage, small kids or reduced mobility
Cash-only / bank-transfer payment and a small breakfast noted by several guests; pool occasionally out of service in low/green season
Classic Khao Sok trade-offs: heat, humidity, insects and sudden rain; WiFi can drop in heavy vegetation/weather, and there is no beach — this is rainforest, not coast
notes:
VERIFIED REAL & OPERATING (2025-2026). This is a LAND jungle lodge in Khlong Sok village, NOT a Cheow Lan Lake raft house. Address: 343 Moo 6, Khlong Sok, Phanom, Surat Thani 84250; phone +66 61 058 2111; official site lasorquideasresorts.com (also khaosokloresort.com / khaosoklasorquideasresort.com). ~9 bungalows only.

GETTING THERE: minivan/shared taxi from Surat Thani town or airport (~1.5h) or from Phuket/Krabi/Khao Lak (~2.5-3h) drops right in Khlong Sok village; the resort is ~2 min from the park HQ entrance so no boat needed. (For a Cheow Lan Lake overnight you drive a further ~1h to Ratchaprapha/Cheow Lan pier + longtail boat — the resort SELLS this as a separate tour/package, e.g. their '4D3N stay + Cheow Lan Lake overnight' combo, but the resort itself is on land.)

BOOKABLE AFFILIATE LINKS CONFIRMED: real Booking.com detail page (booking.com/hotel/th/khaosok-las-orquideas-resort.html, ~824+ verified reviews, overall 8.8/10, couples 9.4) and real Agoda detail page (agoda.com/khaosok-las-orquideas-resort/hotel/khao-sok-suratthani-th.html, internal id h14873881) — both live. Add cid=1965862 to the Agoda URL at publish. TripAdvisor d1385846 (4.7/5, 614 reviews). Also listed on Traveloka, HotelsCombined, Trivago, Airpaz.

UNCONFIRMED: I could NOT confirm a specific Trip.com hotel-detail-page URL, so tripUrl and scoreTrip are left blank rather than fabricated. Agoda's own aggregate overall score was not separately extractable (JS-rendered page blocked WebFetch) — I used the Booking 8.8/10 as scoreAgoda proxy; treat as approximate. Room-type PRICES are realistic estimates (booking sites JS-blocked live rates): TripAdvisor shows a $33-$181/night range and HotelsCombined avg ~$84 / low ~$52, consistent with a ฿1,800 floor. Verify exact nightly rates and room names on the live Booking/Agoda pages before publishing hard numbers.

name: Montania Lifestyle Hotel
zone: Khlong Sok village / near park HQ (land jungle lodge)
highlights: Top-rated stay right in Khlong Sok village — TripAdvisor #1 of the local B&Bs/inns (4.4/5), ~8.9/10 on Booking/Agoda aggregate, so an easy, well-reviewed base for the national park
Standout breakfast: guests repeatedly praise the spread with homemade Thai pastries and a proper menu, not just a token buffet
Lovely tranquil outdoor pool plus garden and, unusually for the village, on-site hot springs — a relaxing jungle-retreat feel
Charming wooden chalets/villas with private balconies and panoramic limestone-karst and mountain views
Genuinely friendly, helpful owners and staff who arrange excursions (Cheow Lan Lake day trips, trekking, kayaking) and transfers
Great walkable location — close to the Khao Sok village main strip, restaurants and the minivan/bus stop, and only a few minutes' drive from the national park HQ entrance
cons: Showing its age in parts: recent 2024-2025 reviews cite maintenance issues — broken/slippery pool tiles, worn towels, tired curtains, hard beds and some musty rooms in older buildings
Intermittent construction/noise reported next door, and some clutter in common areas at times

This is a LAND lodge in Khlong Sok village, NOT a Cheow Lan Lake raft house — no floating-bungalow-over-the-water experience; the lake and Ratchaprapha pier are a further ~40-60 min drive plus a longtail boat, usually done as a paid day tour

Typical Khao Sok rainforest conditions apply — heat, humidity, insects and sudden rain; there is no beach, this is jungle-and-lake country, and the in-house lake excursions are priced at a premium some guests found steep
notes: VERIFIED REAL and currently operating (2025-2026). Located at 68 Moo 6, T. Khlong Sok, A. Phanom, Surat Thani 84250 — i.e. Khao Sok / Khlong Sok village, a LAND-based jungle lodge near the park HQ (3-min drive to Khao Sok National Park, ~11 min to Cheow Lan/Ratchaprapha Lake). NOT a lake raft house. 3-star boutique, ~18 rooms/wooden chalets with balconies, outdoor pool + kids pool + 3 hot springs, on-site Thai restaurant (07:00-21:00), free WiFi/parking, tour desk, bike rental. Scores: Booking.com 8.9/10 (location 9.1); HotelsCombined aggregate 8.9/10 from ~1,647 reviews; TripAdvisor 4.4/5 from ~285 reviews, ranked #1 of the local B&Bs/inns — supports the 'best-rated in the village / family favourite' claim. On Agoda, Booking, Trip.com, Expedia, Hotels.com, Traveloka, Priceline. Pricing: typical paid rate ~US$42/night average, standard rooms seen ~US$34-43 (~฿1,200-1,500) up to US$67-70+ (~฿2,300-2,500) for larger/deluxe chalets; room-type prices above are realistic estimates, not exact live quotes.
